title: Is Crypto Adoption on Wall Street Real Or Hype? Litecoin Founder Charlie Lee
summary: In this episode of Voice of Web3 powered by CoinGape, Sunil Sharma, CEO of CoinGape, sits down with Charlie Lee, creator of Litecoin and one of the earliest pioneers of the cryptocurrency industry, for a wide-ranging conversation on privacy, institutional adoption, stablecoins, AI, tokenization, smart contracts, and the long-term evolution of crypto. The post Is Crypto Adoption on Wall Street Real Or Hype? Litecoin Founder Charlie Lee appeared first on Lite Strategy Inc. .
